item.title: Footpath Cotmandene Crescent to Horsell Road, 18th October
item.description:
There are numerous bottles and broken glass scattered along the pedestrian pathway, as well as fallen leaves and branches. Since my previous report regarding the cleaning of this area, it has still not been cleaned. Despite regular street cleaning, this pathway is consistently neglected and overlooked until it becomes heavily littered, and nothing seems to be done until another complaint is submitted. This is unacceptable. The pathway should be included in regular cleaning schedules and maintained properly, rather than being left in such a poor and potentially dangerous condition until residents have to complain again. I would appreciate it if this issue could be addressed as soon as possible and appropriate measures taken to ensure the pathway is cleaned regularly.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Horsell Road, St Paul's Cray, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
